# Documentation Updates Saved Replies

## Documentation Update Required

**Use case**: When documentation is missing for a code change.

```markdown
Hi @username,

Thank you for your PR! To ensure users and contributors can make the most of these changes, we require documentation to be updated.

**What’s Needed:**

- Add or update README, in-line comments, or usage guides
- Document any new features, options, or changes in behavior
- Ensure new functions/scripts include usage examples

**Resources:**

- [Documentation Standards](.github/instructions/documentation-standards.md)

Let us know if you need pointers on what to document!
```

## Documentation Quality Improvements

**Use case**: When documentation is present but could be improved.

```markdown
Hi @username,

Thank you for including documentation! Here are a few suggestions to make it even better:

- Clarify or expand usage examples
- Organize information with headings and sections
- Add links to related guides or resources
- Use consistent terminology with the rest of the docs

Well-documented code makes it easier for everyone—thanks for your attention to detail!
```
